description: Buffered multiple copying one input to three outputs twice over, or one input to all six

params.text: Up copies IN A to the first three output jacks and IN B to the last three; down copies IN A to all six and leaves IN B unread

inputs.text: The signal copied to the first three output jacks, and to all six when the mode switch is down; a polyphonic cable keeps all its channels
The signal copied to the last three output jacks while the mode switch is up; with the switch down this jack is not read

outputs.text: A buffered copy of IN A, carrying the same number of polyphonic channels
A buffered copy of IN B while the mode switch is up, or of IN A when the switch is down
